versions.changelog:
Initial release of map-the-work skill.

- Provides a structured method to map how work is actually performed, emphasizing evidence over hearsay or documentation.
- Distinguishes clearly between documented, observed, and reported (tacit) views of a process.
- Outlines a mapping protocol to identify process boundaries, gather evidence, document flows, and expose invisible and tacit work.
- Introduces a standardized output format to capture triggers, outcomes, flows, decisions, handoffs, systems, variants, tacit work, friction, evidence status, and material gaps.
- Specifies stop conditions and common pitfalls to ensure focused, actionable mapping without premature optimization.
